1.web: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, And the grave is ready for me.
1.asv: My spirit is consumed, my days are extinct, The grave isreadyfor me.

2.web: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
2.asv: Surely there are mockers with me, And mine eye dwelleth upon their provocation.

3.web: “Now give a pledge, be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
3.asv: Give now a pledge, be surety for me with thyself; Who is there that will strike hands with me?

4.web: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you shall not exalt them.
4.asv: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: Therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

5.web: He who denounces his friends for plunder, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.
5.asv: He that denounceth his friends for a prey, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.

6.web: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
6.asv: But he hath made me a byword of the people; And they spit in my face.

7.web: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
7.asv: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, And all my members are as a shadow.

8.web: Upright men shall be astonished at this. The innocent shall stir up himself against the godless.
8.asv: Upright men shall be astonished at this, And the innocent shall stir up himself against the godless.

9.web: Yet shall the righteous hold on his way. He who has clean hands shall grow stronger and stronger.
9.asv: Yet shall the righteous hold on his way, And he that hath clean hands shall wax stronger and stronger.

10.web: But as for you all, come on now again; I shall not find a wise man among you.
10.asv: But as for you all, come on now again; And I shall not find a wise man among you.

11.web: My days are past, my plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
11.asv: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, Even the thoughts of my heart.

12.web: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.
12.asv: They change the night into day: The light, say they, is near unto the darkness.

13.web: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,
13.asv: If I look for Sheol as my house; If I have spread my couch in the darkness;

14.web: If I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’ to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘my sister;’
14.asv: If I have said to corruption, Thou art my father; To the worm, Thou artmy mother, and my sister;

15.web: where then is my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
15.asv: Where then is my hope? And as for my hope, who shall see it?

16.web: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
16.asv: It shall go down to the bars of Sheol, When once there is rest in the dust.
